facts.fact: 一个月前，Estiene 站到 Jehan 房门口，僵直地告诉他该认真考虑前途、两人最好别再继续；Jehan 自嘲地把往事当作 Duke's Bridge 下的水
facts.anchor: spectacular, ugly fashion a month ago, when Estiene had knocked on Jehan’s room door

facts.fact: Chancellor 在 knocking room 撞见 Estiene 几乎正在把人捅死，这一说法由 Luc Pasquier 在人群中转述
facts.anchor: had discovered Estiene practically in the act of stabbing someone to death

facts.fact: Luc 惊觉 Ysabel（Caudotte）的 burnout 可能是谋杀，事件由一桩命案变成两桩
facts.anchor: Two murders. Can you imagine the Head Healer’s face

facts.fact: Master Doulze 报出死者是 Academie 的老资格 artificer Floris Decroy，并提到他留下的妻儿
facts.anchor: One of our longest-serving— I simply can’t understand why— Oh, his poor wife and son

facts.fact: Thoury 叙述：按惯例午间开会的资深教员委员会打开塔楼房间，发现 Estiene 站在尚有体温的 Decroy 尸体旁，另持带血刀与一张约见便条
facts.anchor: standing over the still-warm murdered body of Artificer Decroy

facts.fact: Estiene 自述：他到约定地点时 Decroy 已死、喉被割、坐在椅上、刀丢在地上；有人在他进门后把门锁上，他自己没有钥匙
facts.anchor: He’d found the man—Decroy—already dead, his throat slit, seated in the chair

facts.fact: Jehan 求 Chancellor 别关人，理由是缺一人他们组只剩四个（已考三案）
facts.anchor: It’ll leave us with only four for our Grand Exam group

facts.fact: Marcelle 以父子二人日后接受关于两桩死亡的一切盘问为条件，换 Estiene 先考完 Grand Exam
facts.anchor: as long as he is allowed to complete his Grand Exam first
